governance.authority: actual host mandate and explicit plan selection
governance.revocation: disable selected settings; keep in-flight readback and receipts

external: explicit GitHub CLI executable and authenticated repository access
optional: Godot/Olympus user interface via their own adapters

access.budget: one create attempt per stable request; no paid model calls

runtime: Python standard library and GitHub CLI
recovery: read back remote exact marker; ambiguous claim never blindly retries; local exclusive lock does not imply cross-machine transaction
compatibility: Only authorized Git-integrated tasks follow their applicable external Issue contract; Olympus local framework work has no external Issue prerequisite, and Olympus follows its own integration rules
